heading: INT. REMOTE ISLAND CLINIC - EXAM ROOM - DUSK

units.text: INT. REMOTE ISLAND CLINIC - EXAM ROOM - DUSK
A whitewashed room with a single shuttered window.
Salt has crusted the sill.
The generator stutters somewhere beneath the floor, and the lights breathe in time with it.
DR. IFEOMA OKONKWO-REYES (40s, tired, hair tied with a bandage strip) bends over the examination bed.
On it lies SALVADOR MENDES (60s, fisherman, grey in the face), his shirt cut open, a clumsy tourniquet around one thigh.
He grips the rail with a knuckle-white hand.
At the foot of the bed, NURSE PAOLO FERRARI (30s) holds a bag of saline above his head with both arms trembling.
At the window, MARISOL MENDES (30s, the patient's daughter) holds the shutters closed as though they might fly open.
Beside her, LOLO the interpreter, short for Eleuterio (50s, wide-brimmed hat), turns a phone over in his hands.
A radio on the shelf gives a crackle of static, then a voice.
Island Clinic, this is Coast Guard Helo Two. Be advised we are forty minutes out. Over.
units.name: COAST GUARD

units.text: Forty minutes. He doesn't have forty minutes.
units.name: OKONKWO-REYES

units.text: Doctor, the pressure.
units.name: FERRARI

units.text: She watches the monitor.
She doesn't answer him.
She checks the tourniquet and tightens it a half-turn.
Salvador groans.
Mr. Mendes. Salvador. Stay with me.
units.name: OKONKWO-REYES

units.text: Papa, listen to the doctor.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Mari.
units.name: SALVADOR

units.text: Marisol leaves the window and kneels at the bed.
She takes his hand.
Lolo says something low in Portuguese, and she nods without looking at him.
Paolo, take over compressions if I call it.
units.name: OKONKWO-REYES

units.text: Yes, Doctor.
units.name: FERRARI

units.text: Lolo, tell her he needs to stay awake.
units.name: OKONKWO-REYES

units.text: She hears you.
units.name: LOLO

units.text: The radio crackles again.
Island Clinic, do you copy? Over.
units.name: COAST GUARD

units.text: Okonkwo-Reyes lifts the handset without turning from the bed.
Copy, Helo Two. Patient is hypovolemic, femoral bleed controlled for now. I need a hoist, a surgeon, and four units of O-negative. Over.
units.name: OKONKWO-REYES

units.text: Roger. We will relay. Hold tight, Doctor.
units.name: COAST GUARD

units.text: She drops the handset and goes back to the bed.
Ferrari has not moved.
His arms shake but the bag stays high.
Doctor, I can switch with Lolo.
units.name: FERRARI

units.text: No. You're fine.
units.name: OKONKWO-REYES

units.text: I'm not.
units.name: FERRARI

units.text: You are. Hold it.
units.name: OKONKWO-REYES

units.text: Marisol presses her father's palm to her cheek.
The generator coughs.
The lights flicker once, twice, and hold.
Outside, far off, the first thud of rotor blades.
